macos_arm64.reason: upstream -pg is unsupported on Apple arm64; explicit Qhull header include needed for direct bin/fpocket target; algorithm sources unmodified

fpocket.center_definition: unweighted arithmetic mean of alpha-sphere centers in pocketN_vert.pqr (three-decimal Angstrom output)
fpocket.footprint_definition: receptor atoms contacted by alpha spheres, from pocketN_atm.cif; residue if >=1 footprint atom; exact source identity mapping and coordinate audit required
fpocket.license: MIT; bundled Qhull and molfile licenses also apply
fpocket.parameters_basis: explicit upstream 4.2.3 headers/fparams.h defaults; no ligand, pocket, chain-selection, or learned re-ranking options
fpocket.randomness: unmodified upstream srand(time(NULL)) for Voronoi perturbation and Monte Carlo volume; no CLI seed available; wall-clock seeding and all raw outputs retained; bitwise repeatability is not claimed
fpocket.ranking: preserve upstream pocket number (original fpocket score order), not druggability or native distance
fpocket.version_banner_caveat: release 4.2.3 source retains internal help banner fpocket 4.0; authenticate by release commit, tarball and executable checksums

receptor_policy.aav_assembly: assembly 1 materialized once with existing identity-operator/60-subunit audit; no reference neighborhood
receptor_policy.alternate_conformers: fail rather than select using a native ligand
receptor_policy.coordinates: preserve source heavy-atom coordinates; no minimization, alignment, protonation, or added atoms
receptor_policy.metals: metal-free discovery baseline; no claim of retained-calcium equivalence to the docking baseline
receptor_policy.nonprotein: remove all waters, metals, ions, glycans and other nonprotein residues uniformly
receptor_policy.other_assemblies: entire deposited receptor supplied to preparer; biological completeness remains a separately qualified condition
receptor_policy.protein: all canonical amino-acid heavy atoms from one complete declared input model; no distance-based selection

scientific_execution: Do not use installation/parser probes in reported denominators; all scientific runs start only after this file is frozen.
